Kriegsmesser	160 gp	1d8	1d10	18-20/x2	—	6 lbs.	S	Blocking

Cost 160 gp Weight 6 lbs.
Damage 1d8 (small), 1d10 (medium) Critical 18-20/x2 Type slashing
Category one-handed Proficiency exotic
Weapon Group heavy blades
Special blocking

Popular weapons of the German Landsknecht, Kriegsmessers (also known as “war knives”) were straight or curved single-edged swords to be wielded in one or two hands. A character can use a kriegsmesser two-handed as a martial weapon.
